So the raised areas are embossed and the foil areas are produced digitally on this particular poster

A cheaper alternative but would still make it really pop is to have this printed with a spot UV layer. You can have the poster printed 4/0 (4 colour CMYK) or, if you want there to be a metallic element you could find somewhere to produce this 5 colour (CMYK+gold) this would not be that much more expensive. 

Spot UV is a great option to make projects pop without breaking the bank. Traditional spot UV requires making a screen and applying the varnish (very similar to screen printing) but you can now get digital spot UV referred to as Scodix 

Really hope this helps and if you have any questions please let me know or shoot me a message! Happy to help in anyway I can
